phrase: World leaders failed to agree on rules for killer robots this week. Meanwhile, an AI algorithm mistook a bag of chips for a gun, sending police after two teenagers.
phraseAlternatives: World powers could not agree on rules for killer robots this week. Elsewhere, an AI system mistook a bag of chips for a gun and sent police after two teenagers.
Diplomats talked for a week about rules for autonomous weapons, then stopped. An ordinary AI system already sent police after two teenagers over a mistaken bag of chips.
Global talks on banning killer robots collapsed this week. A smaller AI mistake already sent police after two teenagers, over a bag of chips mistaken for a gun.
alt: A split scene. On the left, a tall robot looms behind a diplomat sitting at a table with an open, blank book, labeled "no rules." On the right, a camera on a pole points down at a bag on the ground while two worried teenagers stand nearby, labeled "false alarm."

brief.concept: Diplomats sit around a table with a blank rulebook for autonomous weapons, a tall robot shape looming unchecked behind them, while on the other side of the frame a small AI eye mistakes an ordinary bag of chips on the ground for a weapon and sends two teenagers into a police stop.
brief.metaphor: The world can't agree on rules for the biggest kind of killer robot, while a much smaller, everyday AI has already decided who looks dangerous.

brief.composition: Split frame divided by a thin vertical line. Left half: diplomat figures around a round table, shrugging over an open, empty rulebook page, a tall robot silhouette looming behind them in shadow; small text 'NO RULES'. Right half: a street scene with a small AI-eye icon on a pole pointing down at a bag on the sidewalk, two human figures standing with hands raised beside a flashing police light; small text 'FALSE ALARM'. Keep each half to 2-3 shapes; limit text to the two short labels.
